title: A removal of an item from the shelf
description: What POST /api/v1/shelf/{key}/remove answers and `ingestion shelf remove --json` prints. The removal appends the person's read decision with cause shelf-remove, keeping the newest read's verdict and lens, so a summary's model read already queued runs on and a kept summary stays in the item's outputs. A second removal appends nothing. An item that is not on the shelf, and that no removal took off, is refused with 409 not_shelved.

key.description: The item's key, which a URL in the path resolves to.

removed.description: Whether this request took the item off the shelf, and false where an earlier removal had.
